description.value: Star House Restaurant is a Chinese restaurant situated on the Trans-Canada Highway in Cache Creek, a classic pit-stop town on one of BC's busiest touring corridors. It offers both dine-in and counter pickup, with online ordering available. Cache Creek sits at the junction of Highways 1 and 97, making it a natural refuelling point for cyclists heading north toward Prince George or west toward Kamloops.
